output.reply: Two proposed directions for this disposable fixture. Both keep one counter, readable Increment and Reset buttons, and use original CSS styling without external assets or libraries. Reference approval applies only to this fixture. Which direction would you like to select in the Workshop?

options.title: Soft glass, quiet feedback
options.detail: A translucent card with a large count and text buttons. Borrows Lucide’s consistent visual weight and Motion’s interaction-feedback concept. Original glass styling; a brief button press effect keeps the count still. Tradeoff: quieter feedback.
options.test: Increment twice to reach 2, then reset to 0. Repeat by keyboard and check that focus stays visible.

options.title: Solid panel, animated count
options.detail: An opaque panel with outlined buttons. Borrows Lucide’s spare visual language and Motion’s animation concept. Original layout; the count briefly scales on increment. Tradeoff: clearer change feedback, more movement.
options.test: Run the same click and keyboard sequence. With reduced motion enabled, confirm the count updates without scaling.
